inputs.style: Iron Maiden-inspired, Fast NWOBHM, relentless sixteenth-note galloping bass, cutting harmonized twin guitars, fast melodic runs, forceful soaring male tenor, driving double-kick accents. 168 BPM, E minor. galloping ostinato answered by a rising twin-guitar phrase; a terse four-syllable chorus hook. NWOBHM E minor, galloping ostinato, twin harmonized leads, forceful tenor, double-kick accents.. English male vocals, raw heavy metal studio performance.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust on the helm, rust on the blade,
We march where the crows have already made their trade.
The standard is torn, the colors are grey,
But the trumpet still screams at the end of the day.

[Chorus]
Hollow crown!
Empty throne!
We bleed for a ghost,
We march on alone!

[Verse]
Three centuries passed in the silent dark,
Yet the order comes down from the frozen mark.
No breath in the lungs, no pulse in the chest,
But the decree is cut on the iron test.
Who is the king? Who holds the line?
The rot in the seat makes the victory blind.

[Chorus]
Hollow crown!
Empty throne!
We bleed for a ghost,
We march on alone!

[Bridge]
He fell in the year of the burning oak,
But the law does not die, it is thick as smoke.
We bow to the dust, we bow to the stone,
Until the weight of the empire breaks us down.

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Hollow crown!
Empty throne!
We bleed for a ghost,
We march on alone!

[Outro]
The last sword is buried in the blackened earth,
The dead emperor keeps his ancient worth.
We sleep in the dirt, the crown stays still,
Waiting for the next to climb the hill.
